description.value: Gnarefuroids who grew up attached to starships fuse hull parts together into a permanent, spaceworthy carapace. Your carapace grants a +3 item bonus to AC and has a Dex cap of +2, a check penalty of –2, a Strength threshold of +2, and one upgrade slot. You can never wear other armor or remove your carapace. This carapace has the analog and comfort traits, and it can be improved by spending credits as if it were normal armor. Your carapace is medium armor in the ceramic group for abilities and for installing upgrades.
